name: bld6_chebyshev_T_derivative_card_distinct_real_roots
informal: Uses Mathlib2.poly_chebyshev_T_card_distinct_real_roots and Mathlib2.lib_chebyshev_T_natDegree_le: Rolle (Polynomial.card_roots_toFinset_le_derivative) gives n = #roots(T_n) ≤ #roots(T_n') + 1 using the poly theorem; conversely #roots(T_n') ≤ natDegree T_n' ≤ natDegree T_n - 1 ≤ n - 1 by the lib degree bound (the cases n = 0, 1 give the zero / constant derivative).
